title: Lockheed, TTSA and killing the Schumer bill

tellings.quote: Maybe that also explains Robert Weiss, the director of Skunk Works, and his connection to Tom DeLonge and TTSA, To The Stars Academy, later in 2017.

plain: Robert Weiss, director of Skunk Works, the secret aircraft division of the defence company Lockheed, was connected to Tom DeLonge, a rock musician, and his UFO research company To The Stars Academy, set up in 2017. Michels offers this as his own theory, without naming a source, and ties it to a later fight over a proposed law from Senator Chuck Schumer to release government UFO records, naming the congressman Mike Turner. It would suggest the defence industry had a hand in how UFO secrets were handled.
